[[File:Plasma_Torpedoes.png|thumb|right|300px|A BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter firing plasma torpedoes.]]
'''Plasma torpedoes''', also known among pilots as '''shieldbuster torpedo''' or '''rotten eggs''', were a special type of weapon specifically configured to overwhelm a vehicle's shields. They were plasma-based and upon impact they released a burst of radiation that was designed to interfere with shields. They were considerably less effective against armor and other protection.<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

==History==
Circa [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the flagship of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]] pirates, the ''[[Blood Brother]]'', used plasma torpedoes during an [[Peace mission to Armath|attack]] against a diplomatic convoy near [[Armath]].<ref name="DRA1">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wing starfighters]] were equipped with two [[T-33 plasma torpedo]]es.<ref name="SoL" />
